welcome: Welcome. Tap the big button to start today's practice.
session_done: That is the end of today's session. Well done!
goal_reached: Goal reached! Keep going, or move on.
time_up: Time is up for this step.
rest: Rest for a moment, and breathe.
play_sa_continue: When you are ready, play Sa to go on.
tap_continue: Tap the big button to go on.
mic_needed: Please allow the microphone, so I can hear your flute.
mic_why: The app listens to your flute to help you. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
read_lesson: This step has a lesson to look at. Ask someone to read it with you, or tap the speaker to hear it.
log_practice: Last step: tell the app how long you practised today.
open_tool: The tool for this step is open.
listening: I am listening. Play a long note.
good_start: Good start. Keep the air steady.
sharp: A little sharp. Blow a little softer, or roll the flute in slightly.
flat: A little flat. Blow a little faster, or roll the flute out slightly.
very_flat: Too flat. Blow a little harder.
airy: The sound is airy. Make the lip opening smaller, and use a little less air.
wavering: The note is wavering. Keep the air pressure even.
too_short: That was short. Take a full breath, and hold it longer.
wrong_note: That is a different note. Check your fingers.
slide_to_target: Listen: from your note, to the target.
echo_intro: Listen to the phrase, then play it back.
level_up: Level up! A longer phrase now.
some_wrong: Some notes were wrong. Try it slower.
early: You are a little early. Wait for the beat.
late: You are a little late. Play right on the beat.
steer_intro: Play the note on each gate to fly through it. Stay silent to glide down.
balloon_intro: Hold the note in tune to blow up the balloon.
falling_intro: Play each note as it reaches the line.
jam_intro: Play freely with the band, using the raga's notes. Start on Sa.
out_of_raga: That note is not in this raga.
quick_intro: Five minutes of practice. First, wake up the tone with a long note.
listen_intro: Sit back and listen. Watch the fingers on the flute.
stars_0: No stars this time. Try it slower.
